title: Mangani
desc: " All men sin and suffer but ho who suffers for the atonment of the sins of others is a great human. " In a small village, on the banks of the Ganges, lived Gopal, the only son of a soldier who had died on the battlefield while he was still a child daughter devi had great attachment to them. Gopal and Devi were playmates and when they grew up, they fell in love with each other. One day, a village belle who was to become an unwedded mother, was about to be thrown out of the village . The son of the headmen was equally to be blamed but nobody pointed out his mistake. It was Gopal who saved the girl from the mass fury and punished the headman's son . He turned his avowed enemy, Gopal's mother sent Gopal to another village where he got a job in the household of the Zamindar. Zamindar's son vilas came home in vacation and to entertain him, Gopal took him to his own village. When they arrived at the village temple Devi had been giving a dance rectical. The occasion was Janmashtmi, Vilas was introduced to Devi. He tried to flout her modesty. Gopal saved her and taught him the lesson of his life. Gopal bid farewell to devi and went to the city to seek a job Devi took a promise from him that he will not try to take the blame of others misdoings on him. His employer, Dhaniram's daughter Rangilee was about to become an unwedded mother too. Gopal took the blame on himself sethji agreed to give Rangile's hand in marriage to Gopal. Gopal left for his village to seek permission of him mother and Devi. Devi misunderstood him she thought he was the father of Rangilee's unborn child. She tried to commit suicide What happened of Rangilee ? Dear Pairous it is not the end but is father the beginning of a new life of a sugar human, To know him you will have to see MAANAVATA from beginning to end

title: Luv Kush
desc: After Ram returns to Ayodhya, Sita is forced to go into exile. She gives birth to twins Lav and Kush, who later go to Ayodhya to attain blessings of Ram and recite the Ramayan.

title: Hameshaa
desc: Childhood friends Yash and Raja fall in love with Rani but their jealousy leads to the death of both Raja and Rani. When Yash comes across her lookalike, his obsession leads him down a dark path.

title: Mazdoor
desc: Dinanath is a foreman in a textile mill who dreams of one day running his own mill more fairly. He leaves the mill after upsetting the management by supporting his mistreated co-workers. With the support and inspiration of a young orphan, Ashok, he has taken in, Dinanath raises the money to buy a property, leading to the eventual realization of his dream. Then Smita enters the picture and everything starts to go wrong.
